subject: Copywriting
title: The Curiosity Gap
description: Learn The Curiosity Gap in one minute.

hook.text: George Loewenstein's 'information gap' theory explains clickbait: when you know a little, you crave the rest.

buildup.text: A headline that reveals too much gets ignored. One that reveals too little feels like spam. The sweet spot is middle.

discovery.text: 'This CEO Made $1B With One Weird Trick' works because it opens a gap only the article can close.

twist.text: Curiosity headline fatigue is real. Readers now recognize the pattern and skip it. The gap closed on the gap.

climax.text: The best modern headlines create curiosity with substance, not tricks. Promise real value and deliver it.

punchline.text: Open a gap, fill it honestly. That's the updated formula.

quiz.question: Who developed the 'information gap' theory behind curiosity?
